cases.description: Most synthetic checkout attempts fail to borrow a database connection. The database still serves direct health queries.
cases.logs: pool active=20 idle=0 waiting=86; acquire deadline exceeded

cases.description: One admin export is intermittently delayed while every available database client is checked out.
cases.logs: checkout waited 900ms; no idle pool clients

cases.description: A subset of order requests fails after transactions stay open for minutes. The application waits for a client while its SQL spans are also unusually long.
cases.logs: pool pending=31; query p95=5s; no idle database clients

cases.description: The public front door returns service unavailable to every synthetic request. The gateway reports zero eligible backends.
Some requests to the image service get HTTP 503 after backend readiness probes flap, while other routes work.
An internal status widget shows a 503 for a single replica. Traffic and the other replicas are healthy.
Order processing is badly degraded across replicas. Compute time is saturated and requests queue up during serialization.
cases.logs: cpu usage=99%; runnable queue=43; quota throttling rising

cases.description: A staging worker burns an entire core on a tight polling loop; production is unaffected.
cases.logs: worker process cpu=100%; profile shows poll_loop

cases.description: Some requests slow down while periodic background compression uses the CPU quota.
Every synthetic search request fails because all serving processes are repeatedly terminated after exhausting their memory limits.
One preview worker's retained heap rises after every garbage collection; user-facing traffic is unaffected.
A subset of file previews fails as preview workers restart when their resident memory hits the configured limit.
cases.logs: exit reason=OOMKilled; resident memory grows across batches

cases.description: Most customer-facing synthetic order updates are late. The group that handles order events is falling far behind broker partition offsets.
The internal audit stream is delayed for a few minutes while a single Kafka partition accumulates a backlog.
Some thumbnails sync late. The topic receives events faster than consumers acknowledge them and the group keeps rebalancing.
Most webhook deliveries fail before reaching the remote listener. TCP connection establishment stalls from two zones.
Some preview requests miss their deadline only while negotiating TLS with the upstream service.
An internal monitor occasionally misses a check while resolving a hostname. No user workflow is affected.
cases.logs: DNS lookup timed out; subsequent lookup succeeded

cases.description: The entire synthetic billing workflow is unavailable because its primary SQL query waits on locks until each request reaches its deadline. Pool checkout remains fast.
A cohort sees slow search results after a query plan switched from an index scan to scanning millions of rows.
One internal report takes longer than usual. The SQL fingerprint shows much higher execution time and no other endpoints are affected.
Most synthetic jobs fail on the new application version immediately after a rollout, while replicas on the previous version succeed.
Only the canary cohort is affected. Enabling the latest feature flag causes its gateway to return 503 because the new health check never passes.
cases.logs: flag rev=12 canary readiness failed; gateway 503

cases.description: One internal benchmark slows immediately after a config change. The previous revision performs normally under the same traffic.
cases.logs: config revision=88 median latency=2x; no user impact

cases.description: A dashboard operator says something seems wrong but provides no timestamp, service name, or user impact.
A synthetic support ticket asks to change the font on a printed conference badge.
Most synthetic users cannot sign in because an identity provider's signing certificate expired. No infrastructure saturation or transport problem was observed.
A single test account receives an authorization denial caused by a missing permission grant. Other accounts work.
All receipt emails display the wrong currency symbol after a translation dictionary typo, but payment and delivery succeed. This report provides no release timeline.
cases.logs: translation-render test: expected £, rendered $; no delay

cases.description: A sample documentation preview displays the literal phrases CPU high, OOM, network timeout and HTTP 503. Monitoring shows normal CPU and memory and every request succeeds. No service incident occurred.
cases.logs: test fixture displayed sample labels only
